summary: R18 机构逻辑与局部范围；四列包装对接尚未通过。21,601 个产品位姿采样、264 次交接边界、2,161 次数量核对与 3,204 个喷头/停转退让状态采样通过。局部检查包含裸料落带、刀槽、抬框离带与出料脚标高。完整机械干涉、WebGL 浏览器及实料性能尚未验收。 21类局部接口、6,461个场景时刻、168,949对候选网格，采样中未检出相交。新增范围包含安装件与固定滑台、喷头架与转子/固定总管/防溅板、相邻去皮工位及夹爪与新安装板。明确配合按规则排除，宽相跳过小于0.2mm的AABB交叠；不证明连续扫掠、完整CAD、公差、叶片膜材或整线包装集成。

rigid_interface_screen.scope: Selected rigid interface scenarios listed in counts: prior 13 interfaces, new mounting members versus fixed heads, gripper halves versus new mounts, adjacent peel stations, and head structures versus rotor, utilities and splash guards. Core/gripper/detail live-to-fixed scenarios use 0.02 s; utility/guard/adjacent additions and conveyor additions use 0.05 s; weighing uses a static pose. Explicit bearing/nut mates, the engagement ballnut versus its screw, and opening-fork follower contact are excluded.  Broad phase skips AABB overlap below 0.2 mm. Flexible leaves, membrane, hoses, intentional internal joints and remaining full-machine interfaces are not validated.
